cells.gaps: No total of local governments is given, so the counts (4 in October 2022; 5 in 2021) are a floor and no share; the newest authorities fact (SOM-002, September 2023) is a mobile-payment demonstration in other Puntland districts, a pilot beside the count. Held rests on a June 2021 fact that also says district use was not yet rolled out nationally; Galmudug and Benadir districts had no system (SOM-006), and nothing is dated inside the last twelve months.
cells.note: A register that bills and receipts payments is live past its Garowe pilot in four Puntland local governments, which is stage 3. Stage 4 needs more than half on a share or a count with a denominator, and the evidence states no denominator.
